# City Council Outreach

## Upcoming Events:

### Town Hall, July 24, 5 to 8 pm at West View Recreation Center (10747 W. 108th Ave)

Please join Mayor Nancy McNally and the Westminster City Council for a town hall to discuss funding improvements for emergency services and neighborhood streets on Thursday, July 24 from 5 to 8 pm at West View Recreation Center (10747 W. 108th Ave).

This town hall will be centered on how our community can increase funding for emergency services and neighborhood streets.   

The City faces two challenges: 

- The City’s ability to repair and maintain our streets to the level that our residents expect has declined due to the rapidly rising cost of concrete, asphalt, and other materials. At our current rate, the quality of our streets will continue to drop over the next 10 years.
- The City's need to build new fire stations in order to close service gaps. Without the necessary investments, Fire and emergency service personnel may not be able to reach a victim within six minutes - which is the window between life and death.

Family-friendly activities, food, and beverages will be provided.  

**Open House: 5 pm to 6 pm** 

Please join us from 5:00 pm to 6 pm for a Fire and Public Works Open House. City staff will have fire engines, wildland fire trucks, paving rollers, hydrants, and other interactive displays for residents and families to learn about how we keep the city safe and moving. 

Residents will have the opportunity to talk to firefighters, emergency medics, roadway engineers, and other hard-working city staff who pave our roads and repair our critical infrastructure 

**Town Hall: 6 pm to 8 pm** 

Through a series of small group exercises, residents will be able to share their thoughts directly with City Council and City leadership about emergency services and neighborhood streets. City staff will also provide an overview of our current city infrastructure.  

**Attend Virtually:**  

Virtual participants will view the livestream from 6 pm to 6:30 pm. From approximately 6:30 pm to 7:30 pm, virtual participants will be shown a QR code and weblink during small group exercises. Virtual participants will participate in the small group exercises through an online survey.  

The meeting will resume at approximately 7:30 pm, and virtual participants will be able to listen to the summaries of the small group discussions. Virtual responses will be collected and shared with City Council and City leadership after the survey closes for the community on May 2.  

Residents can participate via the City’s YouTube channel and Facebook page. In the event of a technical issue, a full recording of the meeting will be posted on Facebook and YouTube following the meeting.  

### Additional Upcoming Events:

Westminster City Council is excited to meet our community and attend many events throughout the year. Residents can also expect to connect with City Council at the following events in 2025. More event dates and information to come: 

- Community Updates with Mayor McNally and City Manager Andrews (Every third Tuesday of the month)

Please visit the City calendar for a complete list of upcoming City-sponsored events.
